description: Implementation of EmailService interface handling email sending functionalities using Spring Mail and Thymeleaf templates, including methods for sending simple text and HTML emails.

classes.name: EmailServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing email sending functionalities, including template-based HTML email composition.

methods.name: sendSimpleMessage
methods.description: Sends a plain text email to the specified recipient with the given subject and text content.

methods.name: sendMessageUsingThymeleafTemplate
methods.description: Prepares and sends an HTML email based on a Thymeleaf template with the given model variables.

methods.name: sendHtmlMessage
methods.description: Helper method to send an HTML email message.
